statements.status_notes: Upstream GCC commit 2fd8866591b5aea7098835f80ab7e176382175ae makes the std::vector<bool> constructors check the element count against max_size() before sizing the bit array, so an excessively large count is rejected instead of wrapping to an undersized allocation. The DHI build of the Debian gcc-13 source applies the constructor checks from this upstream fix as a patch, so the packaged libstdc++ includes them. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-114691

Upstream GCC commit c1f32b67510f6f9998deadaef5090b6663adb979 enlarges the border table used by the libstdc++ parallel std::search implementation by one element, so the border computation no longer writes past an undersized internal buffer. The DHI build of the Debian gcc-13 source applies this upstream fix as a patch, so the packaged libstdc++ includes it. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-114690

Upstream GCC commit 524847fec983eaedca147840ce46fcbb0cd38952 makes libstdc++ std::from_chars for floating-point types stop before reading past the end of its input for a lone sign character, and removes an out-of-bounds read in the buffer handling. The DHI build of the Debian gcc-13 source applies this upstream fix as a patch, so the packaged libstdc++ includes it. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-115456
